attempts.summary: Built a 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster from scratch on node1/node2/node3 (bare AlmaLinux 9.6 hosts had no MariaDB installed), loaded it with application data, performed a full clean shutdown of all three members for a maintenance window, then brought the cluster back up (bootstrapping from the node with the highest committed seqno) with all committed writes intact and all three members serving. Also completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart/reboot protocol on each node, confirming changed boot identity and full cluster/data recovery after each.
